retained_image_byte_limit: sum of the two largest actually calibrated verified ELF file sizes; same formula and value for every arm; no candidate-dependent tuning
resource_scope: Retained executable file bytes and declared input-buffer bytes are separate bounded model resources, not measured native RSS or an OS memory cap. Initial artifacts remain charged to retained bytes. A newly used artifact is reproposed, independently verified and rebuilt once per arm; later regions reuse the same hash-bound bytes.
candidate_scope: Actual HIA baseline plus independently verified guarded-small, guarded-wide and guarded-narrow-wide. Retain the rejected unguarded body and every failure. No generated candidate is called profitable before measurement. Profitability and competition are measured outcomes, never eligibility filters.
state_contract: The complete already-acquired artifact set, remaining regions, exact current budget and own completed observations are part of state. Shared activation is charged once. Exact DP and native NDU use the same per-event Q32 objective and all best feasible paths per first action. Native recursion is not a learned model.
model_update: After each actual run, dynamic arms update that artifact's calibration latency by the latest observed outer-wall/calibration ratio, bounded to [1/4,4] with integer arithmetic. All dynamic arms use the same update. Fixed-best-plan commits its exact-DP calibrated plan before its first region. No arm sees another arm's observations or future measured times.
oracle: Before heldout timing, compare the DP result against independent Cartesian enumeration on the first four measured regions with the same budgets/capacities. Development random cases and native wire checks are mechanism controls, not heldout economic outcomes.
order: Five arms rotate by group and reverse on odd groups; no optional stopping, rerun selection, or sample deletion. The same disclosed shapes and calls, different fixed heldout seeds, are used by all arms.
prospective_rule: Commit this protocol, collector, planner, tests and all runtime source dependencies before any formal calibration or heldout execution. Supply that exact registration commit to the runner. A failed attempt is retained; changes require a new study id and prospective registration, not replacement of this protocol after outcomes.
cost_accounting: Each standalone arm is charged the entire observed common preparation/calibration/oracle/driver/source work once, its actual decision/admission/reproof/build/loading/work/evidence costs, and its own controller setup. Native NDU also reports its exact original observed build costs separately; a missing outer empty-target build receipt leaves complete cold cost unknown. Common calibration does not excuse later per-arm rebuilds. Acquisition, human work, persistent storage and final aggregate result write remain explicit unknown/excluded costs, never zero.
competition_gate: At least two distinct nonbaseline single-artifact complete-horizon portfolios must have strictly positive modeled savings against the complete baseline portfolio, with full one-time activation and every registered region charged, and at least two distinct nonbaseline artifacts must actually be executed across admitted study episodes. This tests profitable alternatives under the shared-acquisition objective, not whether each region alone repays the whole build. If absent, record competition_not_established and do not claim a useful adaptive-choice regime. Do not enlarge calls or remove activation costs after observing failure.
primary_acceptance: All five arms must finish all registered regions with independent checksums and actual budgets satisfied. Native values/frontier must equal exact same-objective Q32 control. Native NDU must have lower complete measured standalone cost than fixed-best-plan, light-greedy-single and exact-q32-dp, with competition gate established and exact native build outer cost known. Two groups are descriptive only; statistical superiority and cross-task generality remain false regardless of sign. Unknown lifetime costs prevent a complete-lifetime gain claim.
native_dp_identification: The native evaluator and exact DP solve the same additive supplied-candidate model; no better model optimum is possible for native NDU. Any actual execution-cost difference must be separated from control overhead and timing/model error. A more sophisticated learned model would need a separately registered equal-information experiment.
